description.zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看。
description.en: The space ID or instance ID of the ISV sub-customer, which is the channel ID. You can view it on the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API删除IM群功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有创建成功的IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)接口创建IM群。

- IM群删除后不可恢复，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
><notice>The API-based IM group deletion feature is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to apply for access.></notice>

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have a successfully created IM group.

- If you do not have a successfully created IM group, call the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) operation to create one.

- A deleted IM group cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.
